claim: The first RASM assembly chain: RASM PHR2,DEFA2,DEFB2,AMODE0;-X, the -X needed or CREF symbol overflow.
The second chain: RASM PHR2,SAMEXPA7 — the notes' own spelling; the shipped file is SAMEXAP7.SRC.
The shipped file ledger opens with PHR6.SRC at 636 lines.
The ledger lists DEFA7.SRC at 3,375 lines — the largest module, the resident executive.
The banked-ROM window is selected through MAPC EQU $D000 MAP CONTROL.
The diagnostics live in block 3: DIABLK EQU 3 DIAGNOSTIC BLOCK.
Attract mode selects block 1 then jumps to the attract vector (ATTR JSR MAPCH1) — block 1 is AMODE1.
The IRQ selects block 2 to draw characters (LDA #2, SELECT CHARS) — block 2 is MESS0, the message/charset block.
The IRQ selects block 7 before drawing the background — block 7 is BLK71, the terrain data.
The resident block assembles at ORG $D000 (DEFA7 + DEFB6 + ROMF8 + SAMEXAP7 occupy $D000-$FFFF).
SAMEXAP7.SRC opens by INCLUDEing PHR6.SRC — every chain shares the PHR6 equate/macro header.
